judgments.yea_description: Voted for H.Res. 894, a House resolution that condemned antisemitism and stated that anti-Zionism is antisemitism. The House adopted it 311-14, with 92 members voting present.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against H.Res. 894, a House resolution that condemned antisemitism and stated that anti-Zionism is antisemitism. The House adopted it 311-14, with 92 members voting present.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for H.R. 815, a $95 billion foreign aid package paid with U.S. taxpayer money. It held $61 billion for Ukraine, $26 billion for Israel and humanitarian aid in Gaza and elsewhere, and $8 billion for Taiwan and Pacific allies. The Senate agreed 79-18, and it became law in April 2024.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against H.R. 815, a $95 billion foreign aid package paid with U.S. taxpayer money. It held $61 billion for Ukraine, $26 billion for Israel and humanitarian aid in Gaza and elsewhere, and $8 billion for Taiwan and Pacific allies. The Senate agreed 79-18, and it became law in April 2024.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to stop the U.S. from selling 50,400 mortar shells to Israel (S.J.Res. 113). The effort failed 19-78, so the sale was allowed.
judgments.nay_description: Voted to allow the U.S. sale of 50,400 mortar shells to Israel, against an effort to stop it (S.J.Res. 113). The effort failed 19-78, so the sale was allowed.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to stop the U.S. from selling thousands of bombs and bomb-guiding kits to Israel (S.J.Res. 26). The effort failed 15-83, so the sale was allowed.
judgments.nay_description: Voted to allow the U.S. sale of thousands of bombs and bomb-guiding kits to Israel, against an effort to stop it (S.J.Res. 26). The effort failed 15-83, so the sale was allowed.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to stop the U.S. from selling 20,000 automatic rifles to Israel's national police (S.J.Res. 41). The effort failed 27-70, so the sale was allowed.
judgments.nay_description: Voted to allow the U.S. sale of 20,000 automatic rifles to Israel's national police, against an effort to stop it (S.J.Res. 41). The effort failed 27-70, so the sale was allowed.
